name: Power BI Best Practice Analyzer Rules
description: Custom BPA rules for Power BI semantic model validation

rules.name: Use DIVIDE function for division
rules.description: Division operations should use DIVIDE() to handle division by zero gracefully.
rules.recommendation: Replace division operator (/) with DIVIDE function to avoid errors.

rules.name: Avoid hardcoded dates in measures
rules.description: Hardcoded dates make measures brittle and hard to maintain.
rules.recommendation: Use date table relationships or dynamic date references instead of hardcoded dates.

rules.name: Use DISTINCTCOUNT instead of COUNTROWS(VALUES())
rules.description: DISTINCTCOUNT is more efficient than COUNTROWS(VALUES()).
rules.recommendation: Replace COUNTROWS(VALUES(Column)) with DISTINCTCOUNT(Column).

rules.name: Avoid FILTER(ALL()) pattern
rules.description: FILTER(ALL()) can be inefficient. Consider alternatives.
rules.recommendation: Consider using CALCULATE with filter modifiers or KEEPFILTERS.

rules.name: Measures should have descriptions
rules.description: All measures should have descriptions for documentation.
rules.recommendation: Add a description explaining what the measure calculates.

rules.name: Measures should be in display folders
rules.description: Group measures in display folders for better organization.
rules.recommendation: Assign measure to a display folder (e.g., 'Sales Metrics', 'Time Intelligence').

rules.name: Text columns should have sort-by column
rules.description: Month names and similar text should sort correctly.
rules.recommendation: Set SortByColumn to a numeric column for proper sorting.

rules.name: Disable auto date/time
rules.description: Auto date/time creates hidden tables and impacts performance.
rules.recommendation: Disable auto date/time in Power BI options and use explicit date tables.

rules.name: Avoid bidirectional relationships
rules.description: Bidirectional relationships can cause ambiguity and performance issues.
rules.recommendation: Use single-direction filtering unless bidirectional is specifically required.

rules.name: Model should have a marked date table
rules.description: Time intelligence functions require a properly marked date table.
rules.recommendation: Create a date table and mark it as a date table in Power BI.

rules.name: Use consistent column naming
rules.description: Column names should follow naming conventions.
rules.recommendation: Use spaces in column names, not underscores. Remove leading/trailing spaces.

rules.name: Measures should have format strings
rules.description: Measures should be formatted appropriately for their data type.
rules.recommendation: Add appropriate format string (currency, percentage, number).

rules.name: Consider measures over calculated columns
rules.description: Calculated columns increase model size. Consider measures.
rules.recommendation: Evaluate if this calculation could be a measure instead of a calculated column.

rules.name: Hide columns not used in reports
rules.description: Key columns and technical columns should be hidden.
rules.recommendation: Hide key columns that are only used for relationships.

rules.name: Table names - no leading/trailing spaces
rules.description: Table names should not have leading or trailing spaces.
rules.recommendation: Remove leading/trailing spaces from table name.

rules.name: Complex measures should use variables
rules.description: Variables improve readability and can improve performance.
rules.recommendation: Consider using VAR statements to improve readability and performance.

rules.name: Document inactive relationships
rules.description: Inactive relationships should have a documented purpose.
rules.recommendation: Add a name or annotation explaining why this relationship is inactive.

rules.name: Avoid SUMX with FILTER
rules.description: SUMX(FILTER()) can be replaced with CALCULATE for better performance.
rules.recommendation: Consider rewriting using CALCULATE with filters instead of SUMX(FILTER()).

rules.name: Model should have description
rules.description: The model should have a description for documentation.
rules.recommendation: Add a description to the model explaining its purpose.

rules.name: Consider BLANK handling in measures
rules.description: Measures that could return BLANK should handle it explicitly.
rules.recommendation: Consider adding explicit BLANK handling with IF(ISBLANK()) or COALESCE.
